<img class="tool-icon" src="../../../../images/tekla/tools/urebarmatch.svg" alt="" width="48" height="48" style="display:block;margin:0 0 1rem;background:#fff;border-radius:8px;padding:4px" />

{{% callout type="info" %}}
**Where to find it:** Applications & Components → Comma → Rebar → `uRebarMatch` (also on the Comma ribbon tab, Rebar block)
{{% /callout %}}

Copies properties of one rebar group to other rebar groups: the spacing, the covers, the bar shape or the range. Pick the source group once, then every target; the properties you switch on are copied from the source to each target. To put one group against another (second layer, side by side, main bars inside a stirrup) use [uRebarStack](../urebarstack/).

**How to use:**

1.  Select the target rebar groups in Tekla, or leave the selection empty. Switch on the properties to copy and click **Apply**.
2.  Pick the source rebar group. When nothing was selected, pick the target rebar groups next and finish the picks with a middle-click.
3.  The status line says how many groups were changed. Groups that were not changed are listed with the reason in a message. The command then asks for the next source and repeats until <kbd>Esc</kbd>; the selection is used for the first round only.

| Option | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| **Spacing** | The spacing type and the spacing values of the source. For an exact number of bars, the number of bars you see on the source is copied. |
| **Start / end cover** | The cover at the start and at the end of the range. |
| **On-plane cover** | The cover of each leg in the bar plane. |
| **Bar shape** | The bar shape and length of the source, placed at the target's own first point. |
| **Range** | The range length and direction of the source, from the target's own start. |

Every target is read back after the change and put back if the result is not the one that was planned.

{{% callout type="warning" %}}
After a native failure partial changes can remain: inspect the reported object and use Undo.
{{% /callout %}}
